plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog pp. 334-335 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AA-T in Sociology (CSU GE pattern). SOC 120 requires SOC 1 (sequenced in Fall Y1). The ENGL 5/COMM 5 choice requires ENGL 1A (sequenced in Fall Y1). 'Major, List A/B' maps to major; 'US History' and 'US/CA Politics' map to core. Footnote 1: PSYCH 1A, HIST 7A/HIST 7B, and CIS 1 must be taken at College of Alameda to count for the specific CSU GE area. The GEOG 1 + GEOG 1L laboratory pair (4 units) or PHYS 10 (4 units) satisfies B1 & B3. Computed total 60. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
